purpose: The participant-facing terminal treatment for every track that was nonterminal at the start of this window. One file per jurisdiction, one entry per track. Data only: the guidance-packet registry loads it, the single authoritative packet-route resolver binds it, and the Briefcase renders it. Nothing here introduces a second resolver, payment path, credit path or rendering path.
authorization: Roger authorized every nonterminal track to receive the strongest complete, safe, repository-supported terminal treatment available now. A production packet is preferred when already safe, current, independently approved, adopted, participant-ready, runtime-bound and non-conflicting; it is never required merely to improve the launch count.
evidenceRule: A treatment may state a fact only when data/rcap-all50/review-artifacts/terminalization-evidence-briefs.json carries it for that exact track. Eligibility, fees, dates, filing addresses, venues, prosecutor consent, waiting periods, hearing rules, signatures, court actions and record availability are all facts. When a required fact is absent from the brief, the treatment states the precise participant-facing limitation and still gives an exact destination and an exact next step.

languageRule.requirement: Every participant-facing string carries both. es must be a real translation written for a Spanish-speaking participant, never a copy of en, never English text with Spanish punctuation, and never a machine gloss that leaves legal nouns in English where Spanish has an ordinary word for them.
languageRule.why: resolveRuntimeText translates a runtime string only when its exact English is in the dictionary; otherwise Spanish degrades to pattern matching. Committing es here makes the Spanish authoritative without editing frozen runtime.

genericReferralRule: A destination is exact when it names the specific court, clerk, agency, prosecutor, program or published resource this track actually goes to. 'Contact a lawyer', 'contact your local court' and 'see your state's website' are generic referrals and are refused.

treatments.complete_guidance: The participant does not file, or another actor controls the process. The product is complete monitoring and next-step instructions.
treatments.exact_supported_deferral: The participant does file and the mechanism is in scope, but a safe filing product cannot currently be provided. The product is the exact reason, destination, next action, gathering list, cautions, escalation and saved handoff.
treatments.deliberate_scope_exclusion: LegalEase cannot safely support the mechanism with current verified sources or product design. The product is the exact product boundary, the supported reason, a plain-language explanation, and a useful destination and next step.

entrySchema.trackId: string — registry track id, exactly as briefed
entrySchema.treatmentBasis: string — why this treatment and not another, in one sentence, resting on the brief

mechanism._element: 1 — what the legal mechanism or process does

stopReason._element: 4 — the exact, supported reason a production packet is not being offered. States the limitation in participant language and never blames the participant.

destination.name: string — exact court, agency, prosecutor, clerk, program or resource
destination.kind: court | agency | prosecutor | clerk | program | resource
destination.url: string | null — only when the brief carries it

nextStep._element: 6 — the exact next action the participant takes

gather._element: 7 — the records, facts and documents to gather or monitor

doNot._element: 8 — what not to sign, file, submit or assume

timing._element: 9 — deadline or timing rule; null when the brief carries no timing rule

afterNextStep._element: 10 — what happens after the participant acts

escalation._element: 11 — useful escalation when the next step does not resolve it

return._note: How to reopen the saved treatment and resume. Never a promise that LegalEase will produce a packet.

nextSteps._note: The ordered list the Briefcase renders. One participant action per entry, consistent with nextStep, destination and timing.

authority.citation: string — operative authority exactly as the brief carries it
authority.sourceRef: string — the brief field it came from

evidenceRefs: string — brief key(s) and any additional committed artifact paths this treatment rests on

fileShape.windowId: string — the terminalization window this batch belongs to
